posts.text: Major Indian banks collectively spent over ₹2,700 crore on printing and stationery. Despite digitization, large volumes of physical passbooks, KYC forms, and deposit slips drive massive paper costs. The State Bank of India (SBI) alone spent ₹986 crore, amounting to ₹2.7 crore daily. A recent analysis highlighted the massive scale of these administrative and operational costs across the sector.
